author: AtditC
body:
Just a little thread about your statistics!

~~Instructions~~

1. go to your Avicus profile page. (http://avicus.net/user/YourName)
2. multiply your online time (ex 39.3 days) with 24 (a day has 24 hours)

3. divide all your kills (ex. 45536) with the result from before.

4. post your "kph" (kills per hour) here! (will be checked) Let's find out which player is the most efficient!

~~My Example~~
39.3 * 24 = 943.2
45536 / 943.2 = 48.2kph (not very good c:)

~~Top five (not updated, I need more time sry:/~~
1st jgkid111 with 92
2nd kycrafft with 83
3rd cinammoncroc000 with 64
4th AwarriorVenom with 54
5th Upsoar with 59
c;
